summary: Legs A day, so extra carbs via pasta at lunch and dinner. Today's wellness-bar protein smoothie is Banana Chai (same one he actually drank the last two mornings), so that covers breakfast with one grab-and-peel egg added - no other breakfast items since everything else has gone untouched for two days running. Lunch brings in Chicken Makhani for variety after Soft Tofu Stew, Pollo Asado and Creamy Chicken Pasta on recent days; dinner is a simple turkey/chicken-and-pasta plate since today's menu has no dedicated dinner entree beyond the high-fat salmon.
